## Trellis: Clip Publish (YouTube Shorts)

Account-aware Shorts publisher. The payload must include `youtube_account_id`. Video upload is delegated to E11 so Clips follow the exact branch/channel selected in Trellis.

### Setup
1. Import and activate E11-youtube-account-upload first.
2. Replace `REPLACE_WITH_E11_WORKFLOW_ID` on the YouTube Upload node with E11's workflow ID.
3. Map all Supabase nodes to the Hub service-role credential.
4. Keep the first upload private while validating the channel destination.

Vertical video up to YouTube's current Shorts limit is classified by YouTube. Google credentials remain in Trellis.
